title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica no relacionamento com clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras alinhadas aos objetivos e ao perfil de cada investidor.

Na EQI, o início da carreira é fortemente focado na formação de pessoas, com um modelo educacional estruturado e progressão de aprendizado intensiva. Esse processo é constantemente avaliado, sendo atrativo tanto para profissionais em fase inicial ou em transição de carreira, quanto para aqueles já experientes que buscam uma instituição que valoriza educação, resultado e evolução contínua.

Etapa Inicial Desde o primeiro dia, o profissional já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos, inserido em um modelo de formação intenso e educacional.

  • Onboarding Integração à cultura EQI, ferramentas e fundamentos técnicos e comerciais necessários para a atuação.
  • Desenvolvimento Comercial Atuação prática com foco em prospecção, geração de oportunidades e fortalecimento das habilidades de relacionamento.
  • Consolidação da Atuação Após o período de adaptação e com a consolidação dos resultados esperados, o(a) Assessor(a) passa a receber carteira de clientes EQI e inicia sua atuação completa, exercitando o modelo de assessoria da EQI com métricas e indicadores que acompanharão ao longo de toda a carreira.
  • Plano de Carreira O desenvolvimento começa já na formação e evolui de forma estruturada, com avaliações em cada etapa e oportunidades de crescimento até posições de maior senioridade.

O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

  • Fit Cultural;
  • Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP (ou interesse em tirar);
  • Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).

Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado;
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia;
  • Feedbacks estruturados;
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta;
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais);
  • Possibilidade real de Partnership.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios:

Salário + PPR Anual

VA/VR de R$ 1.812

Plano de Saúde Unimed

Se a resposta é sim, venha com a gente!

--

Você fará parte do time de Cliente da Plaza, responsável por transformar nossos clientes em fãs e garantir que conseguirão ter uma experiência ótima com nossos produtos de IA. Seu papel será essencial para o crescimento da empresa — e a sua evolução será proporcional ao valor que gerar.

SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, curiosidade natural e sede de aprendizado e evolução;
  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em São Paulo, SP.

Informações Adicionais:

Obs.: somos obcecados por velocidade. Todo o processo pode acontecer muito rápido.

title: Business Owner in Brazil I Logistics & E-commerce
description:
Lead the Expansion of a Global Brand in Business Services in Brazil

Are you a C-level executive looking to transition into entrepreneurship, or an established business owner seeking to diversify your portfolio?

Mail Boxes Etc. (MBE), a global leader in logistics, shipping, printing, and business solutions, is offering an exclusive Master Franchise opportunity in Brazil. We are seeking a driven, strategic partner to develop and lead the brand's presence across the country.

Why Mail Boxes Etc.?

With more than 1,800 business centers in over 40 countries, MBE is a trusted brand supporting SMEs and consumers worldwide. Our diversified service offering and globally tested systems make this a unique opportunity for business leaders looking to make a measurable impact in a dynamic and growing market.

What We Offer

  • Exclusive territorial rights for Brazil
  • Comprehensive training and operational support
  • Proven business model with global network
  • Scalable income potential through franchise network development

As the Master Franchisee, you will:

  • Launch and operate a corporate pilot center to establish the brand locally
  • Recruit, train, and support franchisees throughout Brazil
  • Provide ongoing sales, operations, and marketing guidance to your network
  • Serve as the strategic leader and representative of MBE in your territory

Is This Opportunity Right for You?

We are looking for a partner who is entrepreneurial, organised, and committed to long-term business success. While prior experience in logistics, or retail is valuable, the ideal candidate is:

  • A proven leader with business development experience
  • Committed to ethical business practices and operational excellence
  • Focused on sustainable, scalable growth

Ready to Lead the Market in Brazil?

This is a strategic business ownership opportunity with long-term potential.

Contact us directly to discuss how you can bring Mail Boxes Etc. to Finland as a Master Franchisee.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Business Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

Responsibilities

  • Own translation of user needs into detailed, ready-to-build requirements for the squad.
  • Define and document benefit hypotheses and testable acceptance criteria for backlog features.
  • Write clear, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria using BDD/Gherkin, user-centric principles and INVEST.
  • Use quantitative data to influence product decisions and operationalize PO-approved plans.
  • Partner with the PO to ensure backlog alignment with business priorities (PO retains final prioritization, scope changes and release sign-off).
  • Keep work 2–3 sprints ahead of the squad; ensure each feature meets DoR and DoD and is sprint-ready.
  • Partner with the Scrum Master to assess team capacity, participate in rituals, and help define DoR/DoD.
  • Facilitate and lead refinement sessions with the squad.
  • Map and manage interdependencies across products and teams; coordinate with PO and Product Manager.
  • Identify key unknowns, propose alternatives, and manage spikes within sprints to reduce risk.
  • Communicate product vision and functional intent to developers and testers; drive improvements to user experience.
  • Communicate risks and impediments; support trade-offs and ROAM-based decision making with the PO.
  • Document confirmed business processes as authoritative references for stakeholders (end users, development, IT support).
  • Identify process bottlenecks and collaborate with PO, SM, QA/TQ and the squad to mitigate them.
  • Support and/or facilitate system demos (inspect-and-adapt) as needed.
  • Support UAT activities as required (write scripts and/or guide business users on test execution), depending on the product.

Skills Required.

  • 5+ years' experience as a Product Analyst.
  • Proven knowledge of product and industry best practices.
  • Strong technical written and verbal English; comfortable with technical documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving and judgment; solid understanding of customer journeys and customer experience.
  • Intermediate SQL for ad-hoc queries and data analysis.
  • Experience managing product backlogs and release plans; tracking team metrics and removing blockers.
  • Proficient with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and tools (JIRA, Confluence).
  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Data warehousing, Data lakes, Data pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of business processes and high-quality digital product delivery.
  • Demonstrated leadership influencing cross-functional, self-organizing teams.
  • Comfortable working in complex, diverse and fast-changing environments; adapts quickly to evolving priorities.
  • Able to deliver high-quality work during uncertainty and ambiguity.
  • Advocates and fosters a data-driven culture focused on measurable outcomes and business agility.
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions and contribute constructive, innovative ideas.
  • Nice to have: IIBA (business analysis) or PSPO/CSPO (Product Owner) certifications — PSPO/CSPO useful if the candidate may act as an ad-hoc deputy PO.

What can you expect from us?

  • Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
  • Opportunities to work outside Brazil
  • A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Well-being & Benefits

Health, dental, and life insurance, meal and transportation vouchers, childcare assistance, Gym pass, and 24/7 support through TCS Cares (psychological, legal, social and financial assistance). Access to cultural, wellness, and recreational programs through TCS- SESC partnership.

Learning & Career Development

Global career opportunities through access to the latest technologies, world-class learning platforms, professional certifications, and mentorship programs designed to accelerate your growth and future-ready skills

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer! title: Cross Border Tech Compliance Adviso
description:
Role Description The Cross Border Tech Compliance Advisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Valparaíso de Goiás, GO. This role focuses on advising SFAP community members and partner organizations on technology-related compliance requirements affecting cross-border finance and accounting activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring relevant regulations and standards, preparing guidance materials, and reviewing processes to ensure adherence to data protection, cybersecurity, and fintech compliance norms. The Advisor will collaborate with stakeholders to assess risk, recommend controls for technology platforms and tools, and support the implementation of compliant workflows. The role also involves conducting awareness sessions and drafting reports, policies, and procedures that are clear, practical, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong knowledge of cross-border compliance, including regulatory frameworks relevant to finance, accounting, and technology-enabled services.
  • Candidates should possess skills in technology risk assessment, data protection practices, and cybersecurity principles related to financial systems and digital platforms.
  • Candidates should possess the ability to analyze complex regulations, interpret legal and technical requirements, and translate them into practical policies and procedures.
  • Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the capacity to prepare clear documentation, deliver training sessions, and engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Relevant experience in compliance, audit, or advisory roles within finance, accounting, or fintech environments is beneficial.
  • A bachelor's degree in law, finance, accounting, information systems, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications in compliance, risk management, or data protection are a plus.
  • Familiarity with regional and international regulatory bodies, cross-border data transfer rules, and industry best practices in governance and ethics is advantageous.

title: Biomédico esteta
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Emagrecentro Palmas é uma clínica renomada no ramo estético, focada em oferecer soluções de saúde, bem-estar e beleza com excelência. Nossa missão é transformar a autoestima e qualidade de vida de nossos clientes por meio de tratamentos modernos e eficazes. Com uma equipe de profissionais qualificados e comprometidos, buscamos continuamente a inovação em nossos serviços.

O profissional também será responsável pelo manuseio seguro de equipamentos de alta tecnologia e pela orientação contínua dos pacientes sobre os tratamentos realizados. Qualificações

  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência em procedimentos estéticos, como aplicação de enzimas, toxina botulínica e bioestimuladores de colágeno.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Comunicação clara e empática, capacidade de realizar atendimento humanizado e habilidade para construir uma relação de confiança com os pacientes.
  • Formação e Regulamentação: Formação superior completa em Biomedicina com pós graduação em Estética e Injetáveis, e registro ativo no CRBM.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia na área estética, cursos de especialização ou aperfeiçoamento em novas técnicas e conhecimentos sobre vendas consultivas no setor de estética.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview:

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students' plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC's Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students' progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students' learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC's Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the Job

We're building Brazil's largest B2B credit infrastructure, and we're looking for a Collections Analyst who is a true negotiation master to play a key role in that journey. You'll be on the front line of debt recovery, negotiating directly — and skillfully — with a wide range of profiles, from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies, always finding the angle that gets deals done while building the kind of trust that strengthens Credix's relationships with its clients. But this role goes beyond collecting: you'll think strategically, analyzing delinquency data, surfacing actionable insights, and helping shape the future of our automation-first collections model. If you're a natural dealmaker, a decisive owner, a clear communicator, and thrive in a dynamic credit landscape, this is the role for you.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers, monitoring payments and driving collection negotiations with the skill of a true dealmaker — efficient, respectful, and always finding a path to resolution.
  • Monitor and control accounts receivable, ensuring financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Use Excel and SQL to analyze data, track key performance indicators, and manage the collections portfolio. Support the automation of operational processes using Python (preferred) to improve efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Prioritize competing demands and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure an excellent customer experience and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned client wallet, negotiating like a true master dealmaker over phone and messaging and recovering outstanding debts across varied customer profiles — from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies.
  • Take ownership of decisions and proactively align with cross-functional teams to solve collection challenges.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions.
  • Analyze delinquency data to generate actionable insights that improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and use tools like Python and SQL to build scripts that improve process efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automated workflows to streamline collections processes.
  • Conduct quality audits of external collection agencies, providing feedback to improve recovery rates.
  • Track performance against KPIs, including recoveries per OKR/Collections Policy and percentage of automated workflows implemented.

What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our São Paulo office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, learn, and grow together.

In addition, we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation, where curiosity is encouraged.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Equity stock options plan.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Clear growth opportunities within collections and operations.
  • Team off-sites focused on collaboration, fun, and shared experiences.

Quais serão as suas atribuições?

title: Compliance Analyst (Compliance Testing)
description:
Compliance Analyst (Compliance Testing)

Location: Brazil

Language Requirement: Advanced English (must be able to participate in meetings, discussions, and professional conversations in English)

Education: Bachelor's Degree completed in Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

About the Role

We are looking for a Compliance Analyst to join the ATE Compliance Program, working closely with the Compliance Program Lead. In this role, you will help ensure that technology and process controls meet internal compliance requirements and regulatory standards.

The ideal candidate will have experience with compliance testing, audit support, control validation, and risk management processes, along with strong communication skills to collaborate with global teams and auditors.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Program Support

  • Understand compliance requirements, policies, and standards, ensuring teams adhere to established controls and procedures.
  • Test and validate controls to confirm they are properly designed and operating effectively.
  • Review compliance evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by collecting, validating, and providing required evidence.
  • Respond to compliance-related inquiries and assist in resolving issues, findings, and escalations.
  • Participate in discussions regarding control design, process improvements, and compliance best practices.
  • Help maintain audit readiness across supported teams and processes.

Compliance Areas Supported

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • Information Security Policies (ISP)
  • Quality Management System (QMS)

Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Support Global and Territory-specific QMS testing activities.
  • Assist with evidence collection, validation, and audit support throughout the year.
  • Ensure QMS controls are consistently followed, documented, and maintained.
  • Monitor compliance with QMS requirements and identify opportunities for improvement.

Stakeholder Management

You will work closely with:

  • IT Product Teams
  • Engineering Teams
  • Security and Risk Management Teams
  • QMS Control Owners
  • Internal Auditors
  • External Auditors

As a trusted compliance partner, you will serve as a key resource for compliance-related guidance, helping teams remain compliant and audit-ready at all times.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree completed in Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced English, including the ability to communicate effectively in meetings and professional discussions.
  • Experience with compliance, audit, risk, governance, or control-testing activities.
  • Knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC).
  • Familiarity with Information Security controls and policies.
  • Experience reviewing documentation, evidence, and compliance records.

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion. title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)

Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.

Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  • Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  • Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  • Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  • Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  • Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  • Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  • Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  • Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  • Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.

Qualifications

A. Experience

  • Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  • Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  • Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  • Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  • Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  • Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  • Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

  • Dairy and non-dairy toppings
  • Premium fruit preparations
  • Chocolate products
  • Bakery creams and margarine compounds
  • Flavor sauces
  • Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: Internal Control Specialist
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking an Internal Controls Specialist to oversee, design, and evaluate the internal control environment across our business units. In this role, you will lead risk assessments, execute internal audit plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and support process owners in developing robust action plans.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, or Risk Management within large corporations or Big Four firms (Deloitte/KPMG/EY/PwC).
  • Advanced knowledge of accounting principles and GRC frameworks (COSO Internal Control & ERM, SOX/J-SOX compliance).
  • Hands-on experience with process mapping, Walkthroughs, Risk & Control Matrix (RCM), and Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis.
  • Advanced or Fluent English (mandatory – both spoken and written).
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Controllership, Risk Management, Finance, or Business Management is preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan and execute end-to-end internal control testing and process reviews across key business areas (Procurement, HR, IT, Tax, Treasury, Fixed Assets, Inventory, Costs, Financial Closing, Entity-Level Controls).
  • Lead the preparation of high-quality internal audit and risk assessment reports with actionable recommendations for executive management.
  • Partner with Business Units (BUs) to design effective remediation action plans and coordinate systematic follow-up activities.
  • Support external audit processes, acting as a primary liaison to align control evaluation results and minimize audit risks.
  • Monitor departmental operational expenses and support budget tracking.
  • Champion quality management, occupational safety, and environmental compliance policies within the department.

Soft Skills:

  • Critical & Investigative Thinking: High analytical capacity to identify root causes, question established procedures, and audit deeply.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Ability to navigate and negotiate effectively across all organizational levels (from floor plant operations to C-level executives).
  • Autonomy & Proactivity: Self-driven professional capable of taking ownership of projects and delivering with minimal supervision.
  • Discretion & Ethical Rigor: Uncompromising commitment to integrity, compliance, and confidentiality.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as CIA, CISA, CRISC, or active CRC.
  • Previous experience in manufacturing/industrial environments.
  • Experience conducting investigative interviews or fraud risk assessments.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (Oracle or SAP).
  • Data analytics skills applied to auditing (Power BI, ACL, Alteryx, or SQL).
  • Mandarin language skills.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

title: Garena Internship 2027
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

Are you ready to be a part of the world's most popular mobile game company? We are looking for driven students to join our Internship Program 2027, where you will have the opportunity to choose your focus track: Operations or Marketing.

You will be an integral part of our core squad, mastering the product from the inside out and taking ownership of the engines that keep the game alive and thriving. This role is designed to fast-track you, tailored to your chosen path:

Operations Track: You will focus on product execution and live systems. Your responsibilities include managing the in-game economy, planning and executing major regional live events, and using data analysis to optimize player retention and ensure seamless daily game operations.

Marketing Track: You will focus on growth, branding, and player acquisition. Your responsibilities include planning and executing high-impact marketing campaigns, analyzing user acquisition (UA) performance data to maximize campaign ROI, and managing local influencer networks and community strategies to expand and engage our player base.

Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Requirements

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Analytical Excellence: Ability to use data to justify operational decisions and optimize the player experience.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 30 hours per week (6h/day) starting January 2027 in São Paulo/SP.

Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

description:

  • acabamentos premium;
  • obras residenciais e comerciais de alto padrão;

  • Estruturar parcerias comerciais de longo prazo;
  • Apoiar a empresa na expansão da marca MH7 no mercado de alto padrão.

---

## *Requisitos*

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas de alto valor;
  • Relacionamento ativo com construtoras, incorporadoras, arquitetos ou clientes do mercado premium;
  • Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário e de interiores em Santa Catarina;
  • Boa comunicação, postura executiva e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil autônomo, estratégico e orientado a resultado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação externa e visitas comerciais;

  • Trânsito comercial em Balneário Camboriú, Itapema, Porto Belo e região;
  • Relacionamento com arquitetos especificadores e profissionais de alto padrão.

  • Estrutura técnica para projetos sob medida;
  • Atuação em mercado de alto padrão;

Esta não é uma vaga para vendedor tradicional.

Buscamos um *executivo comercial*, com visão de mercado, relacionamento estratégico e capacidade de gerar negócios relevantes no segmento de móveis planejados de alto padrão.

title: [Produto RH] Gerente de Experiência do Cliente
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Liderar estrategicamente a operação do Centro de Special Ops de Produto RH, orquestrando as ações de acolhimento, estabilização, normalização e handover das contas estratégicas de clientes de RH; Atuar inicialmente com foco nos produtos das linhas Datasul e RM, com expansão futura para as linhas Ahgora, Feedz e Protheus; Atuar de forma proativa na gestão de crises, identificando situações de risco e conduzindo diagnósticos precisos e planos de ação para recuperação das contas; Liderar squads dedicadas, garantindo o direcionamento das ações necessárias para estabilização e normalização da experiência dos clientes; Promover a recuperação da experiência e do relacionamento com os clientes, contribuindo para a retenção das contas e para a geração de novas oportunidades de negócio; Atuar em uma posição de nível gerencial, com reporte para a Gerência Executiva de Planejamento e Negócios; A posição está inserida na Diretoria de Produtos e Negócios para RH, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Plataformas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar ativamente na gestão de crises e no relacionamento estratégico com stakeholders executivos dos clientes, conduzindo alinhamentos de contexto, reuniões presenciais ou virtuais e apresentações executivas de ganhos concretos;
  • Dialogar com os diferentes envolvidos, desde as áreas internas de Produto até os tomadores de decisão dos clientes, principalmente das áreas de TI e RH, atuando como consultor de confiança e referência em práticas e processos de Recursos Humanos e suas aplicações nos produtos TOTVS;
  • Assegurar a execução dos diagnósticos de processos, imersões técnicas nos ambientes dos clientes e planos de ação acordados, garantindo uma interlocução fluida com parceiros internos e externos;
  • Gerir, capacitar e desenvolver times multidisciplinares formados por Líderes de Projetos e Analistas Especializados em Processos e Serviços, promovendo evolução contínua, feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento;
  • Garantir a alocação eficiente da capacidade produtiva das squads, possibilitando o atendimento simultâneo de múltiplos clientes em diferentes estágios do processo e maximizando a eficiência da operação;
  • Conduzir o handover estruturado das contas normalizadas para o atendimento padrão da companhia, assegurando a continuidade e a perenidade dos resultados alcançados;
  • Identificar e gerar oportunidades comerciais para a oferta de serviços agregados, como AMS, BSO e PRIME, ao final do ciclo de normalização;
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho da área, incluindo tempo de ciclo, evolução das contas e KPIs de melhoria, propondo ações para a evolução contínua dos processos e ferramentas da operação;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento orçamentário da área, garantindo também a adequada gestão de riscos e custos dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo. Pós-Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência sólida, mínima de 3 anos, em posições de liderança de equipes e gestão de contas corporativas no segmento de Tecnologia/SaaS;
  • Experiência comprovada na condução de projetos de recuperação de contas, turnaround ou gestão de crises de alta complexidade.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Vivência com o ecossistema de soluções de RH da TOTVS, preferencialmente com as linhas Datasul e RM.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Comercial Agrícola Anhumaí Ltda atua na cadeia produtiva do amido de mandioca, com foco na qualidade, segurança e conformidade do produto final. Em um setor que exige controle rigoroso, a empresa busca aprimorar seus processos para reduzir riscos microbiológicos e atender aos limites estabelecidos pela legislação vigente.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à avaliação de fontes de contaminação por Bacillus cereus, analisando dados desde a matéria-prima no campo até o produto final estocado. O objetivo é identificar pontos críticos e desenvolver estratégias de controle que fortaleçam a segurança e a qualidade do amido de mandioca.

Se você tem perfil analítico, interesse em microbiologia, qualidade e segurança de alimentos, essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com melhorias técnicas e gerar impacto direto na cadeia produtiva.

Projeto:

Avaliação de fontes de contaminação microbiológica e desenvolvimento de estratégias de controle de Bacillus Cereus em amidos de mandioca.

Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado em Microbiologia, Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas.

Principais Atividades:

  • Relatórios técnicos periódicos;
  • Protocolos de monitoramento e controle microbiológico;
  • Pareceres técnicos;
  • Procedimentos operacionais para mitigação da contaminação por Bacillus cereus;
  • Relatório final consolidado do projeto.
  • Monitoramento microbiológico do processo produtivo.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

  • Conhecimento em microbiologia de alimentos;
  • Métodos de análise microbiológica e interpretação de resultados;
  • Análise de dados aplicada ao monitoramento microbiológico.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre Bacillus cereus;
  • Ferramentas de qualidade e melhoria contínua, como APPCC e ciclo PDCA;
  • Desejável conhecimento em legislação sanitária aplicável a alimentos;
  • Conhecimento do processo de produção de amido de mandioca ou processos correlacionados.

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Presencial / Tamboara - PR

Soft Skills: Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento crítico, Proatividade e organização.

title: [Produto RH] Coordenador de Experiência do Cliente
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Garantir o direcionamento tático das squads e a gestão ativa da carteira de clientes sob sua responsabilidade. Atuar na prevenção de cancelamentos, na resolução de crises táticas e na condução contínua do relacionamento com os decisores dos clientes. Assegurar a estabilidade da receita e a aplicação da metodologia estabelecida. Atuar em uma posição de nível de coordenação, com reporte para a Gerência de Special Ops de Produto RH. A posição está inserida na Gerência Executiva de Planejamento e Negócios, que integra a Diretoria de Produtos e Negócios para RH, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Plataformas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar a saúde operacional e relacional da carteira sob sua gestão, atuando preventivamente na mitigação de riscos de cancelamento (churn) e na retenção da receita recorrente da célula;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para Gerentes e Diretores das áreas de RH e TI dos clientes, conduzindo reuniões periódicas, alinhando expectativas e validando planos de ação;
  • Assegurar a aplicação do método em quatro etapas — Acolhimento, Estabilização, Normalização e Handover — pela squad, acompanhando a evolução das contas e atuando na remoção de impedimentos táticos;
  • Gerir, orientar e avaliar o desempenho dos analistas e especialistas da célula, promovendo alinhamento operacional, capacitação e feedbacks contínuos;
  • Gerenciar a capacidade da célula, orquestrando a alocação de recursos para garantir o atendimento simultâneo e equilibrado da carteira, buscando eficiência operacional e um clima organizacional saudável e positivo;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão e cross-selling de novos serviços, como AMS, BSO e PRIME, ao longo da jornada do cliente, qualificando as demandas para direcionamento à área comercial;
  • Monitorar os indicadores táticos da carteira, incluindo tempo de ciclo por etapa, taxa de normalização, SLAs e custos operacionais, reportando desvios e respectivos planos de ação à gerência da área.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Gestão de RH, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência consolidada na gestão de times operacionais e gestão de carteira/Customer Success em empresas B2B, como SaaS, Serviços de RH ou TI;
  • Vivência prática em gestão de crises táticas e atendimento a níveis de gerência e diretoria;
  • Domínio de indicadores de retenção e operação, como SLA, Churn, MRR/ARR, LTV, CSAT e NPS;
  • Conhecimento em processos de RH e TI e metodologias de gestão de projetos.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimentos em produtos de RH TOTVS.

description:

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Assistant Aeronautical Systems Designer
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for an Assistant Aeronautical Systems Designer to support the development of electrical and hydromechanical systems projects in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professional will have the opportunity to develop knowledge in aeronautical design, supporting multidisciplinary teams during all phases of product development, from conception to certification. This position is intended for early-career professionals who wish to develop in the area of Aeronautical Systems Design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the organization of bills of materials (BOM), component lists, and other project documents;

  • Assist in the updating and control of engineering documents;
  • Support the preparation of technical presentations and reports;
  • Assist in the analysis of interferences and integration between systems;
  • Support manufacturing, assembly, installation, and testing activities of systems when necessary;
  • Participate in the team's technical meetings, contributing to their professional development;
  • Comply with the engineering processes, procedures, and standards established by the

Requirements

Education

• Technical course in Mechanics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Electromechanics or related areas.

Desirable:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics or Aeronautical Engineering (in progress).

Experience

  • No prior experience required.
  • Internship experience, apprenticeship programs, or work in an industrial or aeronautical environment will be considered a plus.

4 – Technical knowledge

Aeronautical Systems Project

  • Basic knowledge of technical drawing;
  • Basic knowledge of mechanical and electrical design;
  • Interest in learning about aeronautical electrical and hydromechanical systems;
  • Basic knowledge of reading and interpreting technical drawings;
  • Basic knowledge of Bills of Materials (BOM).

Aeronautical Knowledge

Basic knowledge in the following will be considered a plus:

  • Aeronautical Product Development Process;
  • Aeronautical electrical systems;
  • Hydraulic systems;
  • Environmental systems (AMS/ECS);
  • Fuel systems;
  • Systems integration;
  • Aeronautical manufacturing process.

Tools

Basic knowledge in the following is desirable:

  • CATIA V5 or 3DEXPERIENCE;
  • Siemens NX;
  • Microsoft Office.

Desired skills

  • Willingness to learn and develop professionally;
  • Organization and attention to detail;
  • Ability to work in a team;
  • Good verbal and written communication;
  • Interest in technology and engineering;
  • Proactivity;
  • Responsibility and commitment;
  • Ability to learn new tools and processes;
  • Ability to follow technical procedures;
  • Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment.

Desirable Skills

The following will be considered a plus:

  • Completed technical course in related areas;
  • Experience with technical drawing;
  • Basic knowledge of CATIA V5 or Siemens NX;
  • Basic knowledge of the aeronautical sector;
  • Participation in academic projects (SAE AeroDesign, Baja, Formula SAE, Aerodesign, Scientific Initiation or similar projects);

Availability

  • Availability for national and international travel, when necessary.
  • Willingness to work different shifts, as needed by the company.

What do we expect

We are looking for curious, organized, and committed professionals interested in building a career in the aeronautical industry. We expect individuals with a willingness to learn, a collaborative spirit, and dedication to developing high-quality engineering solutions. This position represents the entry point to a Systems Design career at Akaer, offering opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

Fixo mensal mais percentual sobre produção. Valores tratados na entrevista.

A triagem é feita diretamente pela direção clínica. Os pré-selecionados respondem a um inventário comportamental (DISC) antes da entrevista final.

Mande mensagem direta aqui pelo LinkedIn com o currículo e um resumo da sua experiência em transplante capilar: técnicas que domina, tempo de atuação e número aproximado de cirurgias já realizadas.

title: Collections Operations Lead - Brazil (LATAM Expansion)
description:
Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology, dedicated to connecting the world through inclusive and innovative solutions. As we expand our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) footprint in Brazil, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Collections Operations Lead to build, scale, and optimize our local operations—with a roadmap to extend coverage across Latin America (including Mexico).

The Role

This is a high-impact, founding role within our Brazil collections team. You won't just manage existing processes—you will build them from the ground up. You will drive end-to-end execution across strategy deployment, BPO management, regulatory compliance, and cutting-edge AI tool integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Operations: Design and execute the full-cycle collections strategy for BNPL in Brazil, from early-stage reminders to late-stage recovery.
  • AI & Tech Innovation: Lead the evaluation, testing, and deployment of AI-driven collection solutions (conversational AI, smart dialers) and multi-channel communications (WhatsApp, Voice, SMS, RCS).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations strictly align with local laws and regulations (LGPD, BACEN, Consumer Protection Code).
  • Data Analytics & Performance: Track core KPIs (Contact, PTP, Cure, Roll, and Recovery rates), build customer segmentation models, and continuously optimize treatment strategies.
  • BPO & Partner Management: Select, onboard, and manage local BPO vendors, ensuring high performance standards and operational alignment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Credit Risk to feed post-loan insights back into underwriting models.
  • Regional Expansion: Scale operational frameworks to support future collections setup in Mexico and other LATAM markets.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have:

  • Fintech/Scale-up Experience: Proven track record in collections operations within leading Fintechs or high-growth consumer credit platforms in LATAM (e.g., 99, Shopee, Nubank, Mercado Pago).
  • Deep Local Market Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of Brazil's collections landscape, BPO ecosystem, consumer behavior, and financial regulations (LGPD, BACEN).
  • End-to-End Ownership: Hands-on experience spanning strategy design, tool implementation, analytics, and vendor management.
  • Fluent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively with global teams.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, or related fields.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Spanish proficiency to support expansion into Spanish-speaking LATAM markets.
  • Direct experience implementing AI voice/chatbots or intelligent dialers.
  • Experience working in multinational or cross-border Fintech environments.
  • Practical SQL or data analysis skills.

Ready to build the future of digital payments in LATAM? Apply now or reach out directly!

title: Analista de Negócios SR - Cobrança/Crédito
description:

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer

Location: Rio de Janeiro (Barra da Tijuca)

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;

Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;

Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;

Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;

Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;

Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced English;

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;

Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.

Nice to have

Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: [Produto RH] Líder de Experiência do Cliente
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Conduzir a execução operacional diária das squads, atuando diretamente com as equipes técnicas do cliente e da TOTVS. Aplicar na prática a metodologia de encantamento, retenção e sucesso no uso dos produtos. Realizar a distribuição das demandas e garantir o cumprimento das entregas técnicas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Atuar em uma posição de nível de supervisão e primeira liderança, com reporte para a Gerência de Special Ops de Produto RH. A posição está inserida na Gerência Executiva de Planejamento e Negócios, que integra a Diretoria de Produtos e Negócios para RH, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Plataformas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar operacionalmente na retenção, executando junto ao time de analistas as ações técnicas e processuais necessárias para solucionar falhas pontuais, garantindo a rápida estabilização da conta e a satisfação do cliente;
  • Atuar como interlocutor diário com coordenadores, analistas e pontos focais operacionais das áreas de RH e TI dos clientes, alinhando rotinas, esclarecendo dúvidas e validando entregáveis;
  • Apoiar e orientar os analistas especializados da squad, distribuindo tarefas diárias, acompanhando a evolução dos chamados e projetos e auxiliando na resolução de problemas relacionados a Processos de RH e Serviços;
  • Organizar o fluxo de atendimento da squad em relação às contas atribuídas, garantindo produtividade diária e evitando gargalos na esteira.
  • Mapear gargalos e necessidades operacionais não atendidas no dia a dia dos clientes, sinalizando ao time comercial e de Serviços Trust potenciais oportunidades de expansão, como AMS, BSO e PRIME;
  • Manter os status dos projetos atualizados nos sistemas internos, garantindo a documentação necessária para a realização fluida do handover.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa ou em fase final em Gestão de RH, Administração, Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de squads ou times de atendimento operacional, ou atuação como Analista Sênior ou Gestor de Projetos Operacionais em TI, BPO ou RH;
  • Conhecimento prático em metodologias ágeis, rotinas e processos operacionais de RH/TI e acompanhamento de SLAs operacionais.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimentos em produtos de RH TOTVS.

title: Banker
description:
Banker – Alta Renda, Private e Wealth

O Grupo Butiá está em plena expansão e busca profissionais experientes para integrar sua área comercial, com atuação no atendimento a clientes Alta Renda, Private e Wealth.

Buscamos bankers e assessores com trajetória sólida no mercado financeiro, visão consultiva e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com empresários, famílias e investidores sofisticados.

No Grupo Butiá, o profissional atua em um ecossistema independente, robusto e multidisciplinar, integrando as soluções da BTA – Assessoria de Investimentos e da Butiá Multi Family Office.

Aqui, o banker não é apenas um distribuidor de produtos. É um advisor completo, com visão patrimonial, profundidade técnica, proximidade com o cliente e mentalidade de sócio.

Principais responsabilidades

O profissional será responsável por:

  • Ser o principal ponto de relacionamento de clientes Alta Renda, Private e Wealth;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva na assessoria de investimentos, com construção e acompanhamento de carteiras personalizadas;
  • Desenvolver novos relacionamentos comerciais alinhados ao perfil do Grupo Butiá;
  • Coordenar, em conjunto com os especialistas da instituição, a visão patrimonial dos clientes;
  • Assessorar clientes na alocação em renda fixa, fundos, renda variável, produtos estruturados e investimentos alternativos;
  • Diversificação em investimentos no exterior;
  • Acompanhar performance, riscos e oportunidades de investimento;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com especialistas em planejamento patrimonial, sucessório e tributário;
  • Participar da estruturação de soluções como fundos exclusivos, holdings, offshore e estruturas patrimoniais;
  • Construir relações duradouras, baseadas em confiança, ética e entrega de valor real.

Perfil desejado

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Experiência como Banker, Assessor de Investimentos, Private Banker ou Wealth Manager;
  • Relacionamento ativo com clientes e capacidade de trazer novos investidores para o ecossistema do Grupo Butiá;
  • Vivência no atendimento a clientes Alta Renda, Private ou Wealth;
  • Perfil consultivo, relacional e orientado ao cliente;
  • Elevado padrão ético e visão de longo prazo;
  • Mentalidade empreendedora, autonomia e senso de dono;
  • Certificação CPRO-R, CPRO-I ou similar.

Certificações como CFP® e CFA serão consideradas diferenciais relevantes.

Sobre o Grupo Butiá

O Grupo Butiá combina assessoria de investimentos, gestão de recursos e multi family office em uma plataforma independente, construída para atender clientes que demandam sofisticação, alinhamento de interesses e visão patrimonial de longo prazo.

Estamos buscando profissionais que queiram crescer junto com o grupo, participar da construção de uma plataforma diferenciada e atuar com liberdade, responsabilidade e profundidade.

Se você tem experiência no atendimento a clientes de alta renda, private ou wealth e busca um ambiente mais independente, consultivo e alinhado ao cliente, queremos conversar com você.

title: Arquiteto de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Mobiis Curitiba, PR (Modelo Híbrido)

Tipo de Contratação: CLT / PJ

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Inteligência Artificial para desenhar e escalar a fundação tecnológica das nossas soluções inteligentes. Este profissional atuará de forma hands-on na construção de integrações avançadas de IA generativa, garantindo que os novos sistemas multiagentes e fluxos automatizados operem com alta performance, segurança e resiliência dentro da nossa arquitetura SaaS voltada para a cadeia de suprimentos e logística.

Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos de arquitetura, desenhar integrações robustas e transformar conceitos de IA em código de produção escalável, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

O que você vai fazer (Responsabilidades)

  • Desenho de Soluções: Arquitetar sistemas de IA integrados aos nossos produtos, incluindo o desenvolvimento de pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e a orquestração de múltiplos agentes.
  • Integração Técnica: Projetar e implementar a comunicação eficiente entre APIs de modelos de linguagem (Gemini, OpenAI) e os nossos microsserviços existentes, garantindo baixa latência e alta disponibilidade.
  • Padronização e Boas Práticas: Definir padrões arquiteturais utilizando protocolos como o Model Context Protocol e frameworks como LangChain para estruturar as aplicações de IA.
  • Infraestrutura e Nuvem: Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de DevOps/SRE para provisionar e otimizar os recursos necessários em nuvem (Azure), garantindo a escalabilidade das operações de IA.
  • Mentoria Técnica: Atuar como referência técnica (Tech Lead) em IA para os times de desenvolvimento, disseminando conhecimento sobre engenharia de prompts, fine-tuning e arquiteturas de software inteligentes.

O que buscamos (Requisitos)

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Arquiteto de Software, Engenheiro de Software Sênior ou Tech Lead.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de backend, especificamente .NET Core (C#) e Node.js, para integrar os motores de IA com as plataformas existentes.
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada com as APIs da OpenAI e/ou Gemini.
  • Domínio em frameworks de construção de aplicações com LLMs, como LangChain, e familiaridade com a implementação do Model Context Protocol.
  • Conhecimento avançado no ecossistema de nuvem (preferencialmente Azure) e padrões de arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados NoSQL (como MongoDB) e ferramentas de mensageria/eventos (como MassTransit).
  • Residir em Curitiba ou região metropolitana, com disponibilidade para o modelo de trabalho híbrido.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia trabalhando com plataformas SaaS de alta volumetria focadas no setor logístico e de transportes.
  • Familiaridade com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para deploy de aplicações de IA.

O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração competitiva e modelo de contratação flexível
  • Ambiente de trabalho flexível (modelo híbrido em Curitiba)
  • Acesso às tecnologias e recursos de nuvem mais recentes para P&D
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico, VR/VA

title: Bolsista Doutor - Delta Etiquetas - Governança Estratégica Integrada | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Delta Indústria e Comércio de Etiquetas está vivendo um momento de evolução e quer fortalecer sua forma de gestão, tornando seus processos mais claros, estratégicos e sustentáveis. Estamos buscando um profissional com olhar analítico e visão estratégica para apoiar essa transformação.

O projeto envolve entender o cenário atual, propor melhorias inteligentes e ajudar a construir práticas de gestão modernas, que apoiem as decisões da diretoria e preparem a empresa para seu próximo ciclo de crescimento.

Se você deseja atuar diretamente na evolução de uma indústria em expansão, com liberdade para propor, implementar e gerar impacto real, esta oportunidade é ideal para você.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Administração ou Engenharia de Produção

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Implementação de Governança Inteligente para sustentar a decisão estratégica da diretoria e institucionalizar cultura organizacional e Conselho Consultivo em uma indústria gráfica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnosticar o cenário atual da empresa, mapeando processos produtivos e administrativos para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.

Conhecimento necessário:

Conhecimento desejável:

Será responsável por analisar resultados, acompanhar custos, orçamento e indicadores, identificar desvios e oportunidades de melhoria, além de apoiar a tomada de decisões por meio de análises financeiras e gerenciais. .

O que buscamos:

A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos.

Os principais produtos incluem carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, caminhões rígidos e plataformas aéreas de trabalho. Principais responsabilidades

1. Gestão da Inadimplência

  • Monitorar diariamente os indicadores de inadimplência (aging, PDD, roll rate, etc.)

  • Controlar vencimentos, prorrogações e alterações contratuais
  • Atuar em inconsistências de cobrança (valores, juros, encargos)

4. Prorrogações e Renegociações

  • Analisar solicitações de prorrogação com base em critérios de risco e política de crédito
  • Formalizar acordos e garantir sua correta execução sistêmica
  • Monitorar o cumprimento dos acordos celebrados

5. Controles e Reporte

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards de cobrança
  • Acompanhar metas de recuperação e explicar desvios
  • Apoiar processos de fechamento financeiro (recebíveis, provisões)
  • Sugerir melhorias em processos, controles e políticas de cobrança

6. Indicadores de desempenho (KPIs)

  • % de inadimplência (aging por faixa)
  • Taxa de recuperação de crédito
  • Quebra de acordos
  • Prazo médio de recebimento (DSO)
  • Eficiência da régua de cobrança
  • Volume de prorrogações vs. recuperação

  • Experiência com ERPs e sistemas de cobrança

  • Automação de processos e uso de dados para decisão
  • Conhecimento em BI (Power BI, SQL, Python)

Competências comportamentais

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

description:
Your Responsibilities:

The Survey & Insights Analyst supports Lockton's enterprise survey consultancy function, partnering with business units and geographies worldwide to design, deploy, and analyze surveys that create actionable insights. This role serves as a hands-on Qualtrics practitioner and analytical partner, helping internal teams translate research questions into survey programs and actionable findings while upholding data governance and privacy standards across regions.

Essential Duties:

  • Design, build, and program surveys in Qualtrics, including logic/branching, bilingual and multi-language routing, embedded data, and distribution workflows.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for survey methodology, question design, and data quality across a portfolio of internal and client-facing survey programs.
  • Partner with stakeholders across regions and business units to scope survey requests, define objectives, and translate business questions into effective instrument design.
  • Clean, analyze, and synthesize survey data into reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and Associates.
  • Support data governance efforts, including PII/PHI risk review, survey inventory management, and adherence to global privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Provide consulting, training, and technical support to survey requestors throughout the survey lifecycle, from intake through post-deployment analysis.
  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical, audiences.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT PMO, Digital Office, and People Solutions teams as needed

Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 1+ years of experience in survey research, data analysis, market research, or a related analytical field
  • Demonstrated experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics (or a comparable enterprise survey platform) required
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data from multiple sources and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality or accuracy
  • Comfortable working across time zones with globally distributed teams; some flexibility in working hours may be required

description:
Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.
